body:
Source: GitHub issue #312 (bug, P1-high, mutation; sibling of #293). Re-verified on main @ 920973bb: packages/review-calibration/lib/verify.mjs verifyWitness (around line 94-100) treats 'passes on original and exits non-zero on mutant' as discriminates:true. A mutant that is syntactically invalid also exits non-zero, and a spawn failure is also non-zero, so the plant is scored as valid and recall is inflated by mutants no reviewer could meaningfully catch. Timeouts are already handled; parse-validity and spawn failure are not.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package packages/review-calibration (lib/verify.mjs runWitness/defaultRun/verifyWitness; lib/scorer.mjs and lib/report.mjs for recall and output; lib/runner.mjs orchestrates). Tests: npm test -w packages/review-calibration. Existing tests (min-plants-floor, witness-diagnostics, scorer, etc.) pin other behaviour. hollow-test already implements the idea (checkSyntax via 'node --check', classifyTestResult) from #306 — read packages/hollow-test for the semantics but DO NOT edit hollow-test or core in this lane (a shared lift into @adlc/core is a follow-up). Grep consumers: grep -rln "verifyWitness\|review-calibration" packages scripts plugins.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Before a plant counts, its mutated file is syntax-checked tri-state (valid/invalid/unknown) with 'node --check' for .mjs/.js files; invalid -> the plant is DISCARDED with reason 'mutant does not parse', never discriminating. unknown (non-JS file, checker unavailable) keeps today's behaviour but the reason records it. ONE exported pure classifier in lib used by every call site.
2. A witness spawn failure (spawn error / shell launch failure 126,127 on mutant OR original run) is an operational result: discriminates:false with an explicit reason, not evidence of a caught mutant.
3. Recall is computed over valid plants only; the report (text and --json) states how many plants were discarded and why. Fail closed: when discarding leaves fewer plants than the existing minimum-plants floor, the existing floor behaviour applies unchanged.
4. Valid-plant behaviour, exit codes and existing output fields unchanged (additive fields only).
4. Documentation: update packages/review-calibration/README.md and make the SAME edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/review-calibration.mdx (hand-maintained mirror — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Regression test of the #293 shape: a multiline 'return {' -> 'return null;' mutant that does not parse is discarded and does not count toward recall. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/invalid-mutant-discard.test.mjs`
- AC2 Spawn failure on witness is not discriminating and carries its own reason. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/invalid-mutant-discard.test.mjs`
- AC3 Report states discarded count; recall denominator excludes discarded plants. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/invalid-mutant-discard.test.mjs`
- AC4 Valid plants still discriminate exactly as before. verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/invalid-mutant-discard.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/review-calibration`
- AC6 Docs updated in both places. verify: grep for the new statement in README and mdx.
- AC7 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also --max 80 locally).

OUT OF SCOPE: lifting the tri-state into @adlc/core or changing hollow-test; other review-calibration issues.
title: review-calibration: a planted mutant that does not parse, or a witness that fails to spawn, is never scored as discriminating
